title: Act: Scaffold game runtime and the-boys-room content
summary: Create createRuntime stub, world YAML content, and loadWorldFromYaml at repo root.
description:
Context: No game module exists.
Desired behavior: Add runtime.ts stub and world-content.yaml plus loader.
Expected result: Runtime and content files are separated; loader parses world id/title from YAML text.
Why: Implements REQ-GAME product code only.
acceptance_criteria: Given Act complete, when inspecting the root, then runtime.ts and world-content.yaml both exist.
Given YAML text for the-boys-room, when loadWorldFromYaml parses it, then id and title match the content file.

preserve: Runtime file separate from content YAML

technical_constraints: Keep world data in YAML files
Do not put prose story content inside runtime.ts
definition_of_done: No test files added by this Act

steps.action: Add dependency yaml ^2.6.0 to existing package.json dependencies without removing React/Vite entries.
steps.expected: package.json includes yaml for content loading.

steps.action: Export type RuntimeState with worldId:string and sceneId:string; export function createRuntime(worldId:string, sceneId:string): RuntimeState that returns { worldId, sceneId }. Do not embed bedroom prose here.
steps.expected: createRuntime returns initial runtime state ids only.

steps.action: Export type WorldManifest { id:string; title:string; startingScene:string }; export function loadWorldFromYaml(source:string): WorldManifest that parses YAML via yaml.parse, requires string fields id, title, startingScene, and throws Error with message mentioning the missing field if any is missing/non-string.
steps.expected: loadWorldFromYaml returns typed manifest or throws on missing fields.

steps.action: Create world-content.yaml with id the-boys-room, title The Boy's Room, startingScene bedroom.
steps.code:
id: the-boys-room
title: The Boy's Room
startingScene: bedroom
steps.expected: Declarative world manifest exists as world-content.yaml.

steps.action: Create minimal bedroom scene YAML with id bedroom, title Bedroom, and description stating a quiet morning bedroom stub for Phase-1 (no interaction graph required yet).
steps.code:
id: bedroom
title: Bedroom
description: A quiet morning in a boy's bedroom. Phase-1 content stub.
steps.expected: bedroom.yaml exists separate from engine source.
